verdict.rationale: BigQuery offers a free 'Sandbox' mode that lets users try queries and transformations without a credit card or billing account, and on-demand pricing gives 1 TiB/month free — both lowering the barrier to a free dev loop. However, there is no evidence of a local engine or offline emulator (unlike e.g. Firestore's emulator); the Sandbox is still a hosted, quota-limited slice of the real cloud service, not a local dev-loop tool. Missing for 10: a documented local/offline emulator, evidence of local development without any cloud dependency, and any hands-on account confirming the sandbox is sufficient for full transformation development before touching production.
